10909255.description: Calyculins are natural products originally isolated from the marine sponge Discodermia calyx.

10989639.name: TCFH
10989639.description: TCFH (N,N,N’,N’-tetramethylchloroformamidinium hexafluorophosphate) is an electrophilic amidine reagent used to activate a number of functional groups for reaction with nucleophilies.

11125959.name: Brookhart's acid
11125959.description: Brookhart's acid is the salt of the diethyl ether oxonium ion and tetrakis[3,5-bis phenyl]borate .

11174599.name: Tetrodotoxin
11174599.description: Tetrodotoxin is a potent neurotoxin. Its name derives from Tetraodontiformes, an order that includes pufferfish, porcupinefish, ocean sunfish, and triggerfish; several of these species carry the toxin.

11203271.name: BL-1020
11203271.description: BL-1020 is an investigational orally-active antipsychotic for the possible treatment of schizophrenia.

11382599.name: Lochnericine
11382599.description: Lochnericine is an indole alkaloid present in the roots of Catharanthus roseus. It is also present in Tabernaemontana divaricata.

11527495.name: Ibodutant
11527495.description: Ibodutant was a candidate drug for irritable bowel syndrome diarrhea, developed by The Menarini Group.

11717831.name: BAY 60–6583
11717831.description: BAY 60–6583 is a selective adenosine A2B receptor agonist.

12130759.name: Zinc nitride
12130759.description: Zinc nitride is an inorganic compound of zinc and nitrogen, usually obtained as grey crystals. It is a semiconductor. In pure form, it has the anti-bixbyite structure.

12300103.name: Betanin
12300103.description: Betanin, or beetroot red, is a red glycosidic food dye obtained from beets; its aglycone, obtained by hydrolyzing the glucose molecule, is betanidin.

15730631.name: Plicatin A
15730631.description: Plicatin A is a hydroxycinnamic acid found in Psoralea plicata.

16007367.name: AMG-517
16007367.description: AMG-517 is a drug which acts as a potent and selective blocker of the TRPV1 ion channel.

16212551.name: Hafnium carbide
16212551.description: Hafnium carbide is a chemical compound of hafnium and carbon.

20831815.name: Nickel(II) nitrite
20831815.description: Nickel nitrite is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula Ni 2.

21195079.name: Glucarpidase

24764487.name: Gefapixant
24764487.description: Gefapixant, sold under the brand name Lyfnua, is a medication used to treat chronic cough.

25147463.name: Thallium(I) telluride
25147463.description: Thallium telluride is a chemical compound of thallium and tellurium.

42607303.name: Eoxin C4
42607303.description: Eoxin C4 , also known as 14,15-leukotriene C4, is an eoxin.

44135495.name: Xylene cyanol
44135495.description: Xylene cyanol can be used as an electrophoretic color marker, or tracking dye, to monitor the process of agarose gel electrophoresis and polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis.

44233671.name: FL3 (flavagline)
44233671.description: FL3 is a synthetic flavagline that displays potent anticancer and cardioprotectant activities.

44384967.name: Lysergic acid 2-pentylamide
44384967.description: Lysergic acid 2-pentylamide , also known as N- lysergamide , is a serotonin receptor modulator and possible psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

44517831.name: AZD9164
44517831.description: AZD9164 is an experimental drug that acts as a potent and selective antagonist of the muscarinic acetylcholine receptor M3.

46853447.name: P7C3-A20
46853447.description: P7C3-A20 is a synthetic chemical compound belonging to the carbazole class.

49802951.name: Mirogabalin
49802951.description: Mirogabalin (brand name Tarlige; developmental code name DS-5565) is a gabapentinoid medication developed by Daiichi Sankyo.

49846599.name: Obefazimod
49846599.description: Obefazimod is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of ulcerative colitis.

53649607.name: 19-Norpregnane
53649607.description: 19-Norpregnane, also known as 13β-methyl-17β-ethylgonane, is a norsteroid and the 19-demethyl analogue of pregnane.

54675783.name: Minocycline
54675783.description: Minocycline, sold under the brand name Minocin among others, is a tetracycline antibiotic medication used to treat a number of bacterial infections such as some occurring in certain forms of pneumonia.

57474247.name: 2C-CN
57474247.description: 2C-CN, also known as 4-cyano-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and possible serotonergic psychedelic of the phenethylamine and 2C families.

73051463.name: Relacorilant
73051463.description: Relacorilant, sold under the brand name Lifyorli, is an anti-cancer medication used for the treatment of ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer, or primary peritoneal cancer.

78076231.name: Chloro(cyclopentadienyl)bis(triphenylphosphine)ruthenium
78076231.description: Chloro bis ruthenium is the organoruthenium half-sandwich compound with formula RuCl 2 .

86764103.name: Razpipadon
86764103.description: Razpipadon (developmental codes CVL-871, PF-06669571, and PW-0464) is a dopamine receptor agonist which is under development for the treatment of dementia-related apathy.

90710983.name: LY-367642
90710983.description: LY-367642 is a potent and selective serotonin 5-HT1D receptor antagonist which has been used in research to study the function of presynaptic 5-HT1D autoreceptors.

102487751.name: Cannabisol
102487751.description: Cannabisol is a phytocannabinoid first isolated from Cannabis sativa in 2012, which is a dimer of THC found in trace amounts in cannabis plant material.

118676295.name: Vicadrostat
118676295.description: Vicadrostat is also known by a number of code names; one of the best known is BI 690517.

121596231.name: Lugdunin
121596231.description: Lugdunin is an investigational antibiotic, classified as a thiazolidine-containing cyclic peptide.

122363719.name: 5-MeO-T-NBOMe
122363719.description: 5-MeO-T-NBOMe, also known as 5MT-NBOMe or NBOMe-5-MeO-T, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to the 25-NB drugs. It has been sold online as a designer drug.

130277831.name: ITI-333
130277831.description: ITI-333 is a drug which has a mixed mechanism of action, acting as an antagonist at the 5-HT2A, D1 and α1A receptors, and also as a partial agonist at the μ-opioid receptor.

136075847.name: Black 7984
136075847.description: Black 7984, Food Black 2, or C.I. 27755, is a brown-to-black synthetic diazo dye. It is often used as the tetrasodium salt.

139030983.name: Phototrexate
139030983.description: Phototrexate is a photochromic antifolate drug developed at the Institute for Bioengineering of Catalonia (IBEC, The Barcelona Institute of Science and Technology).

139263047.name: Selenium tetraazide
139263047.description: Selenium tetraazide is an inorganic chemical compound with the formula Se 4. It is a highly sensitive explosive, and has been prepared directly from selenium tetrafluoride and trimethylsilyl azide.

149252039.name: Osmium tetrasulfide
149252039.description: Osmium tetrasulfide is an inorganic compound, a salt of osmium metal and hydrogen sulfide acid with the chemical formula OsS4.

154824519.name: Chloro(pyridine)cobaloxime
154824519.description: Chloro cobaloxime is a coordination compound containing a CoIII center with octahedral coordination.

164938183.name: Rentosertib
164938183.description: Rentosertib is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis .

165360199.name: 2C-B-aminorex
165360199.description: 2C-B-aminorex is a recreational designer drug with psychedelic and/or stimulant effects.

168322631.name: Isotonitazepyne
168322631.description: Isotonitazepyne is a benzimidazole derivative with potent opioid effects, which has been sold as a designer drug over the internet.

170843463.name: Praseodymium hexaboride
170843463.description: Praseodymium hexaboride is a binary inorganic compound of praseodymium and boron with the formula PrB6. It forms black crystals that are insoluble in water.

172875719.name: 1S-LSD
172875719.description: 1S-LSD, also known as 1-(3- propionyl)-LSD, is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

178316487.name: LIT-002
178316487.description: LIT-002 is a small-molecule oxytocin receptor agonist which is under investigation for potential medical use, with possible indications including autism, drug addiction, and neuropathic pain.

900000199.name: Asfotase alfa
900000199.description: Asfotase alfa, sold under the brand name Strensiq, is a medication used in the treatment of people with perinatal/infantile- and juvenile-onset hypophosphatasia.

900000327.name: Bupivacaine/meloxicam
900000327.description: Bupivacaine/meloxicam, sold under the brand name Zynrelef, is a fixed-dose combination medication used to treat pain in small to medium-sized wounds after surgery.

900000455.name: Chlorinated polyvinyl chloride
900000455.description: Chlorinated polyvinyl chloride is a thermoplastic produced by chlorination of polyvinyl chloride resin.

900000583.name: Des(1-3)IGF-1
900000583.description: des IGF-1 is a naturally occurring, endogenous protein, as well as drug, and truncated analogue of insulin-like growth factor 1 .

900000711.name: Emactuzumab
900000711.description: Emactuzumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody directed against colony stimulating factor 1 receptor expressed on macrophages and has demonstrated a profound antitumor effect through interference...

900000967.name: IHCH-8110
900000967.description: IHCH-8110 is a peripherally selective and non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist.

900001223.name: Maftivimab
900001223.description: Maftivimab is a Zaire ebolavirus glycoprotein-directed human monoclonal antibody that is part of the fixed-dose combination atoltivimab/maftivimab/odesivimab that is used for the treatment of Zaire...

900001351.name: Neptunium(III) phosphide
900001351.description: Neptunium phosphide is a binary inorganic compound of neptunium metal and phosphorus with the chemical formula NpP.

900001479.name: Paraffin wax
900001479.description: Paraffin wax is a soft colorless solid derived from petroleum, coal, or oil shale that consists of a mixture of hydrocarbon molecules containing between 20 and 40 carbon atoms.

900001607.name: Poly(methacrylic acid)
900001607.description: Poly is a polymer made from methacrylic acid (preferred IUPAC name, 2-methylprop-2-enoic acid), which is a carboxylic acid.

900001735.name: QazCovid-in
900001735.description: QazCovid-in, commercially known as QazVac, is a COVID-19 vaccine developed by the Research Institute for Biological Safety Problems in Kazakhstan.

900001863.name: Seraticin
900001863.description: Seraticin is an antibiotic discovered by scientists at Swansea University able to inhibit 12 different strains of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus , as well as E.

900001991.name: Tellurocyanate
900001991.description: Tellurocyanate is the polyatomic ion [TeCN]−, consisting of a tellurium atom bonded to a cyanide group.
